decisive_items: curettage yielded a gelatinous, soft, mushy tissue
There was no tenderness on percussion of the involved teeth
response.rationale: The tissue consistency and chronic, non-tender presentation favor periapical granuloma over abscess; the abscess label was only provisional and is contradicted by the curettage findings.

rejected.why: Periapical abscess would typically yield pus and often cause percussion tenderness; the gelatinous, soft, mushy tissue and lack of percussion tenderness support granuloma instead.
